desc: Count the frequency of each character in the string.
Sort the frequencies in descending order.
Iterate over all possible target frequencies k from 1 to n.
For each k, iterate over the number of distinct characters m from 1 to min(26, n // k).
For each (k, m), compute the cost using the formula: cost = sum(abs(freqs[i] - k) for i in range(m)) + n - m * k.
Track the minimum cost across all (k, m) pairs and return it.
